name: ConfigWatch
roles: Security Engineer I · Security Automation Engineer
headline: Know exactly what drifted.
description: Compare a versioned baseline with actual configuration, then inspect an approval-gated repair plan.
guide: Inspect disabled audit logging, short retention, public storage, and missing MFA in the sample.
Approve applying the plan to the isolated copy. Compare before, after, and rollback snapshots.
Edit the baseline or import your own sanitized JSON. Unsafe property paths are rejected.
limits: The engine reads and modifies JSON copies. It does not connect to a cloud account, enforce organizational policy, or mutate host settings.
